French

[edit]
French Wikipedia has an article on:
grenouille
Wikipedia fr

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • gournouille, guernouille, gueurnouille (Louisiana)

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Middle French (g)renouille, from Old French (g)renoille, from Vulgar Latin *rānucula, diminutive from Latin rāna (“frog”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɡʁə.nuj/
    • Audio:(file)
  • (Louisiana) IPA(key): /ɡrə.nuj/, /ɡɾu.nuj/, /ɡuɾ.nuj/, /ɡæɾ.nuj/, /ɡœɾ.nuj/
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)
  • Rhymes: -uj
  • Homophone: grenouilles

Noun

[edit]

grenouille f (plural grenouilles)

  1. frog
    Synonyms: ouaouaron m (Louisiana), raine f (Louisiana or obsolete)
  2. (Louisiana) any small, green frog (e.g., leopard frog, tree frog, etc.)
  3. (Louisiana, vulgar) female genitals (clarification of this definition is needed.)

Hypernyms

[edit]
  • (animal): animal, batracien, amphibien, lissamphibien

[edit]
  • crapaud
